channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The intense battle over who profits from AI-generated music
item.description: AI can create songs in seconds, but determining who gets paid and how is a complex issue. Legal and industry fights have already begun.

item.title: Portland soap box derby blends downhill racing with creative pageantry
item.description: Soap box derbies feature motorless cars racing downhill. At one event, participants design their cars as cartoon characters, subway cars, food items, and more.

item.title: U.S. and Iran miss peace talks deadline; Alaska, Florida and Wyoming primaries ahead
item.description: The U.S. and Iran failed to start peace talks by the deadline this week. The prolonged war has drained U.S. resources. Also, key details on Alaska's upcoming primary.

item.title: Federal trial begins in child safety case against Meta
item.description: Four states accuse Meta of knowing its platforms harmed children and failing to act. Opening arguments are now underway.
